analysis: MNF day update. The market has settled at Saints -2.5, total 47.5-48.5, moneylines near -110 both ways. New Orleans' defense is badly short-handed: linebackers Kaden Ellis, Pete Werner and Anfernee Jennings plus edge Carl Granderson were all DNPs (about 62% of the Saints' LB snaps), and RB Travis Etienne is out. Atlanta is without top corner AJ Terrell. With those priced the sim makes Atlanta a 0.6-point favorite, so the +2.5 covers about 58% of the time.

The earlier Under 47.5 read was mostly a model artifact: using only real 2026 games the projection is 47.2, essentially the market number, and both defenses are now missing key pieces. Atlanta's offense with Michael Penix back (35 points last week, Bijan Robinson 200+ yards) against the league's 31st-ranked run defense and a gutted linebacker room is the cleaner angle.
